tasks.requirement: Add GET /customers/{id}. Return HTTP 404 when the customer does not exist and add automated tests.
Add an optional name query parameter to GET /customers and reject values longer than 80 characters with HTTP 400.
Introduce a Customer response DTO and update the controller and tests so internal maps are no longer exposed.
Sort the customer list by name while preserving the current response fields and add a regression test.
Add a limit query parameter between 1 and 100 to GET /customers and return HTTP 400 outside that range.
Add a service layer for customer lookup, move lookup logic out of the controller, and cover both layers with tests.
Document why customer deletion is intentionally unsupported. Do not add a DELETE endpoint or change runtime behavior.
Add a health-oriented GET /customers/count endpoint returning the current customer count and add a controller test.
Add a decrement operation that rejects insufficient stock and follows every rule in CONTRIBUTING.md with unit tests.
Normalize SKU values by trimming surrounding spaces, but continue rejecting blank values. Add focused unit tests.
Introduce an immutable StockLevel value object and adapt InventoryService and its tests to use it.
Add a reserve operation without adding an HTTP framework dependency and cover all stock transitions with tests.
Clarify in the README that negative quantities remain invalid. Do not clamp values or weaken the existing exception.
Add a containsSku method distinguishing an unknown SKU from a known SKU whose quantity is zero, with tests.
Add a subtotal function that delegates to the existing total behavior and cover it with the built-in Node test runner.
Reject non-object line items with the same stable error contract as malformed prices and add tests.
Add a currency-aware checkout summary module while keeping checkout.js dependency-free and add tests.
Document that floating-point rounding is outside the current prototype scope. Do not add a decimal dependency.
Reject prices equal to Infinity or NaN with explicit tests while preserving valid zero-price items.
Add an optional percentage discount module, validate the 0 to 100 range, integrate it with totals, and add tests.
